name: EntraSync Node Storage
description: Provides node storage settings for EntraSync.
project_description: Submodule of EntraSync. Provides the `node` EntraSyncStorage plugin (NodeStorage), which turns each distilled Microsoft Entra user into a Drupal node of a chosen content type. It maps Entra properties to node fields, sets the node title from a chosen property, controls published/unpublished state, and can create a new revision when synced data changes. Nodes are matched to Entra users through the base module's managed-entities table; a node is unpublished when its Entra account is disabled and skipped if never created. Requires the base entrasync module. Depends on core Node.
